test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Meenakshi could have sent a reply.

options.text: A reply could have be sent by Meenakshi.
A reply could have been sent by Meenakshi.
A reply could have sent by Meenakshi.
A reply could have been send by Meenakshi.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Meenakshi could have sent a reply."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a reply" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "could have sent" to "could have been sent" (perfect modal passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Meenakshi."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A reply could have been sent by Meenakshi."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A reply could have be sent by Meenakshi." – Incorrect verb form (should be "been" instead of "be").
 
• **Option 3: **"A reply could have sent by Meenakshi." – Incorrect structure (missing "been").
 
• **Option 4: **"A reply could have been send by Meenakshi." – Incorrect verb form (should be "sent" instead of "send").
